supplemental_artistic_observations.first_impression_without_intensity_label: An attentive adult stage worker pauses in a damp canal-side rehearsal setting; warm fabric and work-lamp tones relate well to the cool water and stage backdrop.

supplemental_artistic_observations.weaknesses: The body reads closer to a slender torso and arms with full upper chest and roomy work trousers, rather than the intended multi-region soft build.
supplemental_artistic_observations.control_calibration: The ordinary work portrayal carries subtle supporting presence; no special erotic or surreal treatment is apparent. Perceived strength and user preference remain separate.
